Class TreeMultiset<E>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
be.imgn.gaia.core.collect.TreeMultiset<E>
Type Parameters:
E - the element type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Multiset<E>, SortedMultiset<E>, Serializable, Iterable<E>, Collection<E>, SequencedCollection<E>
public final class TreeMultiset<E> extends AbstractCollection<E> implements SortedMultiset<E>, Serializable
A modifiable sorted multiset backed by a TreeMap, the multiset counterpart of TreeSet. Its ordering must be consistent with equals: two elements are the same element when they compare equal.
  • It iterates in ascending order, with all occurrences of an element in a row.
  • It rejects null elements. Querying it with null, as in count(null), throws NullPointerException unless its comparator accepts null.
  • Its views and entries are live, and its iterators support Iterator.remove().
  • Its iterators fail fast when an element is added or removed while they iterate, outside of their own remove(). A change of the count of an element already there does not disturb them.
  • Finding, adding and removing an element take a time logarithmic in the number of distinct elements. Collection.size() takes a constant time on the multiset and its reversed view, and a time linear in the number of distinct elements on a range view.
  • It is serializable if all its elements and its comparator are. A view is serialized as a copy.
  • It is not thread-safe.
Since:
0.1.1
